sys_hub_flow.description:
Start Full Instance Scan on the provided instance. This will internally make a call to a REST API and returns the Instance Scan progress result.

Inputs:

  • Instance URL - The URL of the Instance where you wish to start the Instance Scan .
  • Credential Alias - The Connection and Credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role.
  • API Version - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified. When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.

Outputs:

  • Status - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled".
  • Error - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
  • HTTP Status - The HTTP status code of the response
  • Status Label - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"
  • Status Message - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Status Detail - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Progress Id - The sys_id of the execution tracker for this request. Can be used to track the progress of the request.
  • Progress URL - The URL of REST endpoint to get progress from sys_id of the execution tracker for this request.
  • Result Id - The sys_id of the result record generated from the scan
  • Result URL - The URL to the result api for a reference
  • Finding URL - The URL of the Finding table where all the findings can be found from the scan
  • Finding Label - Information to customer that 10,000 records are shown

Error Messages:

  • User does not have access to CICD role
  • The scan exceeded the time allowed
  • Multiple Full Scans cannot run at the same time
  • The scan completed. However, one or more individual checks failed.

To use this action, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the Instance URL used above. Learn More

sys_hub_flow_snapshot.description:
Start Full Instance Scan on the provided instance. This will internally make a call to a REST API and returns the Instance Scan progress result.

Inputs:

  • Instance URL - The URL of the Instance where you wish to start the Instance Scan .
  • Credential Alias - The Connection and Credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role.
  • API Version - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified. When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.

Outputs:

  • Status - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled".
  • Error - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
  • HTTP Status - The HTTP status code of the response
  • Status Label - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"
  • Status Message - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Status Detail - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Progress Id - The sys_id of the execution tracker for this request. Can be used to track the progress of the request.
  • Progress URL - The URL of REST endpoint to get progress from sys_id of the execution tracker for this request.
  • Result Id - The sys_id of the result record generated from the scan
  • Result URL - The URL to the result api for a reference
  • Finding URL - The URL of the Finding table where all the findings can be found from the scan
  • Finding Label - Information to customer that 10,000 records are shown

Error Messages:

  • User does not have access to CICD role
  • The scan exceeded the time allowed
  • Multiple Full Scans cannot run at the same time
  • The scan completed. However, one or more individual checks failed.

To use this action, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the Instance URL used above. Learn More

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_hub_flow"><sys_hub_flow action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><acls/><active>true</active><allow_high_security_roles>false</allow_high_security_roles><annotation/><attributes/><authored_on_release_version/><callable_by_client_api>false</callable_by_client_api><category display_value="Instance Scan">9336efa9530000104733ddeeff7b12c0</category><copied_from/><copied_from_name/><description><p>Start Full Instance Scan on the provided instance. This will internally make a call to a REST API and returns the Instance Scan progress result.</p>
<p><b>Inputs:</p>
</b>
<ul>
   <li><b>Instance URL</b> - The URL of the Instance where you wish to start the Instance Scan .</li>
   <li><b>Credential Alias</b> - The Connection and Credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role.</li>
   <li><b>API Version</b> - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified.  When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.</li>
</ul>
<p><b>Outputs:</p>
</b>
<ul>
   <li><b>Status</b> - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled".</li>
   <li><b>Error</b> - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.</li>
<li><b>HTTP Status</b> - The HTTP status code of the response</li>
   <li><b>Status Label</b> - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"</li>
   <li><b>Status Message</b> - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.</li>
   <li><b>Status Detail</b> - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.</li>
   <li><b>Progress Id</b> - The sys_id of the execution tracker for this request. Can be used to track the progress of the request.</li>
   <li><b>Progress URL</b> - The URL of REST endpoint to get progress from sys_id of the execution tracker for this request.</li>
   <li><b>Result Id</b> - The sys_id of the result record generated from the scan</li>
   <li><b>Result URL</b> - The URL to the result api for a reference</li>
   <li><b>Finding URL</b> - The URL of the Finding table where all the findings can be found from the scan</li>
   <li><b>Finding Label</b> - Information to customer that 10,000 records are shown</li>
</ul>
<p><b>Error Messages:</p>
</b>
<ul>
   <li>User does not have access to CICD role</b></li>
   <li>The scan exceeded the time allowed</li>
   <li>Multiple Full Scans cannot run at the same time</li>
   <li>The scan completed. However, one or more individual checks failed.</li>
</ul>
<p> To use this action, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the Instance URL used above.  <a target="_blank" href="https://docs.servicenow.com/search?q=Create+a+Connection+%26+Credential+alias">Learn More</a></p></description><display_name_after_preview/><flow_priority/><generation_source/><internal_name>instance_scan_execute_full_scan</internal_name><label_cache>[{"name":"subflow.credential_alias","label":"Input➛Credential display_value="Instance Scan">9336efa9530000104733ddeeff7b12c0</category><copied_from/><copied_from_name/><description><p>Start Full Instance Scan on the provided instance. This will internally make a call to a REST API and returns the Instance Scan progress result.</p>
<p><b>Inputs:</p>
</b>
<ul>
   <li><b>Instance URL</b> - The URL of the Instance where you wish to start the Instance Scan .</li>
   <li><b>Credential Alias</b> - The Connection and Credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role.</li>
   <li><b>API Version</b> - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified.  When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.</li>
</ul>
<p><b>Outputs:</p>
</b>
<ul>
   <li><b>Status</b> - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled".</li>
   <li><b>Error</b> - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.</li>
<li><b>HTTP Status</b> - The HTTP status code of the response</li>
   <li><b>Status Label</b> - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"</li>
   <li><b>Status Message</b> - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.</li>
   <li><b>Status Detail</b> - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.</li>
   <li><b>Progress Id</b> - The sys_id of the execution tracker for this request. Can be used to track the progress of the request.</li>
   <li><b>Progress URL</b> - The URL of REST endpoint to get progress from sys_id of the execution tracker for this request.</li>
   <li><b>Result Id</b> - The sys_id of the result record generated from the scan</li>
   <li><b>Result URL</b> - The URL to the result api for a reference</li>
   <li><b>Finding URL</b> - The URL of the Finding table where all the findings can be found from the scan</li>
   <li><b>Finding Label</b> - Information to customer that 10,000 records are shown</li>
</ul>
<p><b>Error Messages:</p>
</b>
<ul>
   <li>User does not have access to CICD role</b></li>
   <li>The scan exceeded the time allowed</li>
   <li>Multiple Full Scans cannot run at the same time</li>
   <li>The scan completed. However, one or more individual checks failed.</li>
</ul>
<p> To use this action, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the Instance URL used above.  <a target="_blank" href="https://docs.servicenow.com/search?q=Create+a+Connection+%26+Credential+alias">Learn
